title: What if you got the Pirate Shop Token?

lines.text: What if you got the pirate shop token?
You open a chest, and something gold spins out. One in a hundred and thirty-seven thousand. You just found the pirate token. Your squad doesn't believe you.
By mid-morning you're in the shop with fourteen free days and one rule: no junk. You buy every skin you've wanted since season one. Thirty-one before lunch.
By noon you're buying for the memories. Every emote. Every pickaxe. Every bundle you skipped. Your locker goes from twelve items to four hundred.
By sunset the hard part starts. Everyone wants to be your duo. Two hundred messages ask for a gift. The token can't gift. So you say no, two hundred times.
At night the fourteen days run out and the shop locks. You open a locker with four hundred items, can't decide, and wear the default.
So if you found the token, what's the first skin you'd buy? And be honest, would you even tell your squad?
